name: stat-band
description: Semantic description list of headline stats with labels, optional hints and column presets.
designIntent: Proof sections repeat the same number/label cluster. StatBand standardizes the scale, dividers and responsive columns, and uses dl semantics so the number-to-label relationship is real structure, not styled divs.

props.name: items
props.description: Stats to display: value, label and optional hint.

props.name: columns
props.description: Desktop column count. Mobile stacks to one column and sm uses two.

props.name: divided
props.description: Draw dividers between stats at sm and up.

examples.title: Proof band
examples.code:
<StatBand
  items={[
    { value: '3,500+', label: 'Advisory firms' },
    { value: '5,000+', label: 'Investors' },
    { value: '12,000+', label: 'Deals annually' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Three proof points with default dividers.

examples.title: Left-aligned four-up
examples.description: Four stats aligned to the left.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use StatBand for app KPIs
antiPatterns.explanation: Use MetricCard when the value needs a delta, trend or loading state. StatBand is a marketing proof strip.

accessibility.implementation: Renders dl/dt/dd so each value is paired with its label
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep labels short and do not put interactive controls inside a stat

accessibility.implementation: Value renders before label visually while dt precedes dd in the DOM
accessibility.userRequirements: Screen readers still receive the label before the value

guidelines: Include a sign or plus when the number is a floor

compositionRules.relationship: StatBand sits inside a Section so the surface tone and padding come from the band
